title: From Live to Recording: Consumer Demand and Response to Price Across the Livestreaming Lifecycle
authors: Ziwei Cong; Jia Liu; Puneet Manchanda
eligible_reason: Not a staggered DiD. The unit is a Zhihu Live event (N = 2,299) observed in two windows: the 30 days before its livestream and the 30 days after (recording). df_combined stacks the two windows and the main specification (code.Rmd lines 230-262, Section 4.1-4.3) regresses log(demand30 + 1) on lnfull_price*after plus live_start_week*after, dayofweek*after and event/creator covariates (lm; felm with week x tag and dow x tag FE). Every event is 'treated' (after = 1 in its own second window), there is no event FE, no calendar-time FE and no untreated comparison; the coefficient of interest is the interaction of a continuous price with the post-livestream indicator (a change in price elasticity). Sections with ivreg (similar-event prices as instruments), DML (Python) and Oster bounds (Stata) are IV/ML variants of the same cross-event comparison.
design_notes: R (lm, lfe::felm, AER::ivreg) in code/code.Rmd; Stata Oster2019_and_IV_test.do (reg, ivreg2); Python DML_lasso.py / DML_rf.py. Abstract: demand is more price sensitive before the event than after, explained by self-selection and lower quality uncertainty once the livestream ends.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Not applicable: event-relative pre/post windows, every unit treated, no calendar-time panel.

ineligible_specs_listed.reason: continuous price x after interaction; no unit or calendar-time FE; all units treated
IV and ML estimators of the same price-elasticity contrast

data_files_note: README: all price- and demand-related variables are rescaled for confidentiality; coefficient estimates may differ at the second decimal.
data_provenance_note: Original Zhihu Live data with price and demand variables rescaled by the authors.
screener_notes: Screened from package, README and OpenAlex abstract (no article text). Pre/post-livestream price-elasticity design; nothing staggered.
